physics-killer-07.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
physics-killer-07.topic: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
physics-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-07.material: Mgbe a na-ele anya site n'ụwa, ebe kpakpando dị bụ afọ ìhè $6$. Ụgbọ elu na-esi n'ụwa gaa kpakpando a n'ọsọ edoro anya $0.6c$ wee rute kpakpando ahụ. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, oge njem onye na-ele anya n'ụwa tụrụ, na oge njem a tụrụ site na elekere dị n'ime ụgbọ elu? (Ọsọ ìhè $c$ bụ afọ ìhè $1$ kwa afọ.)
physics-killer-07.thinking.0: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
physics-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe a na-ele anya site n'ụwa, ebe kpakpando dị bụ afọ ìhè $6$. Ụgbọ elu na-esi n'ụwa gaa kpakpando a n'ọsọ edoro anya $0.6c$ wee rute kpakpando ahụ. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, oge njem onye na-ele anya n'ụwa tụrụ, na oge njem a tụrụ site na elekere dị n'ime ụgbọ elu? (Ọsọ ìhè $c$ bụ afọ ìhè $1$ kwa afọ.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.explain: Onye na-ele anya n'ụwa: $\Delta t=\dfrac{6\text{ afọ ìhè}}{0.6c}=10$ afọ. $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.6^2}=1/0.8=1.25$. Elekere ụgbọ elu na-atụ mmalite na ọbịbịa n'otu ebe, yabụ ọ bụ oge nke onwe ma $\Delta t_0=\Delta t/\gamma=10/1.25=8$ afọ. Ọ bụrụ na e mụbaa, $12.5$ afọ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ③); ọ bụrụ na e kewaa site na $\gamma^2$, $6.4$ afọ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e gbanwere uru abụọ, azịza na-ezighị ezi ④. (Site n'echiche ụgbọ elu, ebe a gbapụrụ ghọọ $6/1.25=4.8$ afọ ìhè ma $4.8/0.6=8$ afọ, nke kwekọrọ.)
